name: Svelta Plastic Surgery

google.note: As quoted on the clinic's own home page, shown as '4.5 2,658+ reviews'. The line itself is not labelled 'Google' but links to a Google Maps page, and the page elsewhere says 'Read all our reviews on Google'. Count is a '2,658+' floor, not verified on Google.

tummy-tuck.includes: Page says quoted prices cover the accredited surgical suite and anesthesia team, with no separate facility fee.
tummy-tuck.conditions: Final cost depends on technique and extent of skin removal. Tummy tuck + BBL combo advertised separately from $8,500.

brazilian-butt-lift.conditions: Final cost depends on amount of fat transferred and areas of liposuction. Marked 'Limited Time' on the specials page, no end date given. Combination packages from $7,500.

mommy-makeover.includes: The $6,500 entry level is described as a tummy tuck plus breast procedure combination.
mommy-makeover.conditions: Page also gives an overall range of $6,500 - $20,000; tummy tuck + breast + lipo from $9,500; with BBL from $12,000. Depends on combination, extent and anatomy.

lipo-360.conditions: FAQ says most cases fall in the $3,000 to $8,000 range. Depends on technique, extent of treatment and anatomy. Lipo 360 + BBL from $7,500.

abdominal-etching.conditions: Depends on extent of sculpting required and anesthesia type.

breast-augmentation.includes: Page says the surgical center and anesthesia are part of the total cost.
breast-augmentation.conditions: Page gives a typical range of $2,800 to $12,000 depending on implant type, surgeon, anesthesia and technique.

breast-lift.text: Breast lift procedures at Svelta start at $4,500
breast-lift.includes: Page says the anesthesia team and accredited suite are reflected in the quoted price, not a separate facility fee.
breast-lift.conditions: Price range shown as $4,500 - $7,000 depending on technique, surgeon and goals. Lift with implants is quoted individually.

breast-reduction.conditions: Also worded 'Procedures starting at $6,500'. Final cost depends on technique, surgeon and individual goals.

gynecomastia.conditions: Also worded 'Procedures starting at $4,000'. Final cost depends on technique, surgeon and individual goals.

rhinoplasty.conditions: Page gives a range of $6,500 to $15,000; complex or revision cases $8,500 to $15,000. Depends on complexity, open vs closed technique, and functional correction.

facelift.conditions: Also worded 'Starting at $12,000'. Final cost depends on technique, surgeon and individual goals.

eyelid-surgery.conditions: Also worded 'Starting at $3,000'. Final cost depends on technique, surgeon and individual goals.

neck-lift.conditions: Also worded 'Starting at $4,500'. Final cost depends on technique, surgeon and individual goals.

bichectomy.text: cost of Buccal Fat Removal in Miami ranges from $2,000 to $6,000
bichectomy.conditions: Worded as a cost 'in Miami' rather than explicitly as Svelta's own fee, so it may be a general estimate. Depends on surgeon, facility and anatomy.

botox-fillers.conditions: PER UNIT price for Botox, not a treatment total; page says most sessions run $300 - $1,200. Dermal fillers are priced separately: 'start at $600', range $600 - $2,500 per session (https://sveltaplasticsurgery.com/dermal-fillers/).

laser-resurfacing.conditions: Fraxel laser, per session; full courses are usually 3-5 sessions with package pricing available. Varies by laser type, area size and number of passes.

financing: Site advertises financing 'starting from $25/week' (e.g. Lipo 360 $25/wk, Tummy Tuck and Breast Augmentation $27/wk, BBL $35/wk, for qualified applicants) through partners including CareCredit, Affirm, Alphaeon Credit, Cherry, Fortiva and MedLoan Finance, plus in-house layaway; no APRs or terms are disclosed.
notes: Identity confirmed from the site's own name and address. Prices were consistent between the home page, /specials/ and the procedure pages for BBL, breast augmentation, mommy makeover and rhinoplasty. Points to check: (1) the home page says 'liposuction starting at $3,000 per area' while the Lipo 360 page says Lipo 360 (full torso) starts at $3,000 - same figure, different scope; (2) the BBL page states combination packages start at $7,500 in one place and '$7,500-$8,500' in another; (3) the breast augmentation page attaches $4,500 both to saline implants (table) and to fat transfer (FAQ); (4) the facelift page has a closing line 'Procedures at Svelta start at $12,000' which is evidently facelift-only boilerplate; (5) /specials/ says specials are subject to availability with limited slots, no expiry dates. All prices are 'starting at'/ranges to be confirmed at consultation. No pages found in the site navigation for arm lift, thigh lift, otoplasty or microneedling, so none recorded. Pages were read through an automated fetch-and-extract tool, so the quoted wording should be spot-checked against the live pages before publication. A search result (not used as a source) suggested the practice recently rebranded from another name.
